su_sd_note: The district brands itself 'Champlain Valley School District' (CVSD) on its website header/title; legal entity is Champlain Valley Unified Union School District #56. schools.csv lists 'Champlain Valley Supervisory Union' (a 2020 Legislature SU map also shows 'Champlain Valley SU'). Same entity, different naming. The 2026-27 catalog itself also calls it the 'Champlain Supervisory School District'. Whether it is formally an SU or a supervisory district was not confirmed from an official source.

issues: Primary is the 2026-27 booklet, linked from the school homepage as a published Google Doc ('updated automatically every 5 minutes', so content can change). The PDF copy was exported (by the pilot) from the underlying Drive doc 1M1S... which carries the same title 'Course Catalog SY 2026-2027.docx' and matches the published content, but that Drive ID was found via search engine, not an official link; the published HTML is also saved. Graduation requirements are on p.6 of the catalog ('CVU's GRADUATION REQUIREMENTS': English 4, Math 3, Science 3, Social Studies 3, Health .5, PE 1.5, Practical Arts .5, Fine Arts .5, Senior Exit .5, Electives 3.5, RISE 2) - no separate grad requirements doc found. The pilot's 1-page grad-requirements Google Doc (1oqW...) was downloaded and checked in this run: it names no school and contradicts the CVU catalog, so it was discarded. No course-planner tool found (pilot did not check explicitly; none mentioned in catalog search).
